Frequently Asked Questions (Prompt Caching Cost Calculator)

How does prompt caching pricing differ between Anthropic Claude and OpenAI GPT-4o?

Anthropic Claude applies an explicit 5-minute TTL cache: writing to the cache costs 25% extra ($3.75/M vs $3.00/M base), but reading from the cache gives a massive 90% discount ($0.30/M). OpenAI automatically caches repeated prompt prefixes longer than 1,024 tokens with no write surcharge and applies a flat 50% discount on cached input tokens ($1.25/M vs $2.50/M base).

What is the break-even threshold for Anthropic Claude prompt caching?

Because Anthropic charges a 25% premium on cache write ($3.75/M vs $3.00/M), you break even on the very second request using that cached prefix within 5 minutes ($3.75 write + $0.30 read = $4.05 for 2 calls vs $6.00 uncached, saving 32.5%). Every subsequent cache read delivers pure 90% savings.

Does DeepSeek support prompt caching?

Yes, DeepSeek natively supports prompt caching on their official API and through OpenRouter. DeepSeek cache hits cost an ultra-low $0.014 per 1M tokens (90% discount off the already low $0.14/M base rate), making context caching virtually free for heavy agentic workflows.
